name: operator==(std::stop_token)

declarations.code: friend bool operator==(const stop_token &lhs, const stop_token &rhs) noexcept;

intro:
Compares two stop_token values.

This function  is not visible to ordinary unqualified or qualified lookup, and can only be found by argument-dependent lookup when std::stop_token is an associated class of the arguments.

The != operator is synthesized from operator==.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if lhs and rhs have the same associated stop-state, or both have no associated stop-state, otherwise false.
